PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFrom:
A shady old guy sucked me into buying this weird fish POKéMON!
It's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMo:
Good things can happen if you raise POKéMON diligently.
Even the weak ones can surprise you if you don't give up on them.
